You set up OpenClaw, Hermes, or maybe even ClaudeClaw, and it's running. But you haven't derived any real business value from it yet. That's because the magic isn't in the dashboard or the agents lighting up. It's in all the grunt work behind the curtain that nobody wants to show on YouTube.

This video walks you through the mental model, the data prep, and the exact skill I give consulting clients to help them self-serve. Three hypothetical operators (e-commerce, law firm, dermatology clinic) show how to apply the same 4-layer framework to completely different businesses.
